description: This script is a command-line utility for fixing translation issues in documentation markdown files by comparing translated versions to English originals and auto-correcting them.

classes.name: typer.Typer
classes.description: CLI application object for command-line interface

methods.name: iter_all_lang_paths
methods.description: Iterates over markdown files in language-specific directories in order of priority.

methods.name: get_all_paths
methods.description: Retrieves paths of documentation files to process, excluding non-translated sections.

methods.name: process_one_page
methods.description: Fixes a single translated document by comparing it to its English version.
